beats.name: Beat 1: Countering Overconsumption with Meaningful Objects

cards.text: Viviana speaks on overconsumption and the value of having items made with intention
Open on a slow vertical pan up of Viviana focused on painting

children.notes: Use the smooth portion of the vertical tilt/pan up to Viviana's face.

cards.text: Followed by a shot highlighting the hand-shaped paint palette
A calm, reflective track begins under natural studio room tone.
Viviana reflects on valuing a single piece and feeling the touch left by the creator
Cut to tight, macro close-ups of Viviana’s brushstrokes and detailed painting on ceramic surfaces to directly reflect her words about the artist’s hand.
Music remains soft and contemplative
Complete pause in interview dialogue
Pure B-roll sequence focusing on the focused craft and texture of the pottery process

cards.notes: Select the most tactile, meditative segment of clay trimming and handling.

cards.text: The reflective music swells slightly alongside subtle ambient clay-handling sounds.

beats.name: Beat 4: Physical Connection and Mud Witch

cards.text: Viviana discusses the importance of physical mediums for genuine connection and community

cards.notes: Trim slightly to fit the beat duration while maintaining core statement on connection.

cards.text: Focused B-roll of hands interacting with tactile finished ceramics
Transitioning into an exterior establishing shot of the Mud Witch sign as the final frame
The music gently resolves at the close.

meta.brief: Plan a ~60-second documentary about how Viviana turned her pottery into Mud Witch and why she values pottery.
meta.guidance:
high elvel structure - overconsumption bad – good to have one thing you care about -- physical medium important for connection

Start with calm reflective song
When talking about feeling where artist hand is close up shot of painting
Physical medium important for connection – focused broll
B roll of Viviana painting pan up – hand shaped paint plate b roll
Pause with just b roll (no interview clips) before the last segment about physical medium
End with mudwitch sign b roll
